blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Linking people’s appearance and actions to character identities is essential for understanding video narratives. We present a framework for identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering that combines automatic character identification, explicit spatial grounding, and task-specific adaptation. Starting from LSMDC v2 movie clips, our pipeline matches detected faces to actor reference images, tracks characters across frames, and builds inputs with identity-linked bounding boxes. A strong vision-language model generates identity-aware captions and questions, which are manually verified and filtered to create a benchmark of 750 captioned clips and 3,000 person-centric questions. We study five grounding strategies combining textual coordinates with visual face or estimated person boxes across Video-MLLM families at roughly 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters and larger frontier models. Combining visual face boxes with textual coordinates yields the most consistent performance across scales and significantly improves overall performance over coordinates alone. Smaller models tend to over-assign known identities when the queried person is not grounded, while larger models better recognize such UNIDENTIFIED cases. We introduce BAC by LoRA fine-tuning Qwen models at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales on about 32K identity-aware captioned clips. Across all scales, BAC outperforms every other evaluated model family of comparable size. BAC-8B reaches 93.20% overall QA accuracy, ranking behind only GPT-5.6 Sol among the frontier models evaluated in our study. Overall, explicitly communicating who is where , together with lightweight task-specific adaptation, substantially improves identity-aware video understanding without changing the underlying architecture. We release the benchmark, training data, code, and BAC checkpoints at https://github.com/momentslab/beyond-anonymous-captions .
blocks.zh: 将人们的外表和行动与人物身份联系起来对于理解视频叙事至关重要。 我们提出了一个认识身份的视频字幕和以人为中心的问题答案框架,其中结合了自动字符识别、明确的空间定位和针对具体任务的适应。 从LSMDC v2 电影剪辑开始,我们的管道匹配检测到的演员参考图像的面相,跨帧跟踪字符,并用身份链接的边框来构建输入. 强大的视觉语言模型产生识别意识的字幕和问题,这些字幕和问题经过人工核实和过滤,以建立750个字幕片段和3000个以人为中心的问题的基准. 我们研究了五个将文字坐标与视觉面孔或估计人物盒相结合的地基策略,这些策略涉及视频-MLLM家族,其参数约为2B、4B和8B参数以及更大的前沿模型。 将可视相框与文字坐标相组合,产生最一致的跨尺度性能,并显著地提高整体性能,仅靠坐标即可. 较小的模型往往在被询问人没有被查禁的情况下过度分配已知身份,而较大的模型则更能识别这类UNIDINTIED案例. 我们以2B,4B,8B的标尺,通过Lora微调Quen模型,在大约32K的能识别身份的字幕片段上引入BAC. 在所有尺度上,业连理事会的绩效都高于所有其他评价的可比规模的模型家族。 BAC-8B达到总质量评估的93.20%,仅次于GPT-5.6 Sol在研究中评估的前沿模型中排名. 总而言之,明确沟通谁在哪里,加上轻量级任务特有适应,在不改变基本结构的情况下,大大提高了对身份意识视频的理解。 我们公布基准、培训数据、代码和BAC检查站,

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Understanding human-centered video requires more than recognizing what happens in a scene. Video-captioning models can describe events, appearances, actions, and interactions in natural language ( Xu et al., 2016 ; Yang et al., 2023 ) . However, these descriptions are typically identity-agnostic: a model may correctly understand what each visible person is doing without determining which character that person corresponds to. In narrative videos such as movies, this distinction is important because scene understanding depends not only on recognizing actions and interactions, but also on attributing them to the correct characters.
blocks.zh: 了解以人为中心的视频需要的不仅仅是识别场景中发生的事情. 视频封装模型可以用自然语言描述事件,外观,动作,以及互动(徐等,2016;杨等,2023. 然而,这些描述通常是身份-不可知性的:一个模型可能正确理解每个可见人物正在做什么,而不确定人物对应的特征. 在电影等叙事视频中,这种区分很重要,因为场景理解不仅取决于识别动作和互动,还取决于将其归结为正确的人物.

blocks.en: At the same time, visual grounding has made substantial progress in associating textual references with corresponding visual regions ( Kamath et al., 2021 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) . Given a textual reference to a person or object, grounding models can localize the referred entity, typically through spatial regions such as bounding boxes. Video captioning therefore provides a mechanism for describing what is happening in a scene, while visual grounding provides complementary information about where a referred entity is located.
blocks.zh: 同时,在将文字参考与相应的视觉区域联系起来方面,视觉地基学也取得了重大进展(Kamath等,2021;Ma等,2024)。 由于文字上提到一个人或物体,地基模型可以使被指实体定位,通常通过诸如边框等空间区域。 因此,视频字幕为描述一个场景中发生的情况提供了一个机制,而视觉地面则提供了被指名实体所在地的补充信息.

blocks.en: This observation motivates the central question of our work: can these two capabilities be combined to support identity-aware video understanding? More specifically, if a Video-MLLM is provided not only with the visual content of a video, but also with explicit information indicating the identity and spatial location of the people appearing in it, can it correctly associate each identity with the corresponding person in the scene? Such an association could allow the model to preserve its existing understanding of appearances, actions, spatial relations, and interactions while grounding that understanding in the correct character identities. More generally, we investigate whether explicit information about who is where can help a Video-MLLM determine more reliably who is doing what, where, and with whom .
blocks.zh: 这一观察激发了我们工作的中心问题:能否将这两种能力结合起来来支持对身份认识的视频的理解? 更具体地说,如果一个视频-MLLM不仅得到视频的可视内容,而且得到明确信息,表明其中出现的人的身份和空间位置,那么它能否正确地将每个身份与现场对应的人联系起来? 这种联系可以使模型保持其对外观、行动、空间关系和相互作用的现有理解,同时将这种理解建立在正确的特征上。 更笼统地说,我们调查的是,关于谁在哪里可以帮助视频-MLLM更可靠地确定谁在做什么、在哪里做什么、与谁一起做什么。

blocks.en: Prior work on identity-aware visual description has approached the problem in several ways. Early movie-naming methods such as M-VAD Names ( Pini et al., 2019 ) associate face tracks with character identities and replace generic SOMEONE mentions in existing captions with the corresponding names, rather than generating identity-aware descriptions directly. A related post-processing strategy is proposed by Tevissen et al. ( Tevissen et al., 2024 ) , who first generate a generic image caption and then use attention maps and identified face regions to replace person mentions with names. In both cases, identity is introduced after the caption content has largely been determined, so people omitted from the original caption cannot naturally be recovered. M-VAD Names indeed formulates its main task as replacing SOMEONE tags in existing captions with proper character names.
blocks.zh: 以往关于认识身份的视觉描述的工作以几种方式处理了这一问题。 M-VAD名称(Pini等,2019年)等早期电影取名方法将面相音轨与字符身份联系起来,并用相应的名称来取代现有字幕中通用的SomeONE提及,而不是直接生成身份意识描述. Tevissen等人提出了相关的后处理战略。 (Tevissen等,2024年),他们首先生成一个通用的图像标题,然后使用注意地图和识别的面相区域来取而代之地用名字来代替被提及的人. 在这两种情况下,在标题内容基本确定后引入身份,因此原标题被省略的人自然无法被找回. M - VAD 软件 名称的确规定了其主要任务,即用适当的字符名称来取代现有标题中的某个ONE标签。

blocks.en: More recent work integrates identity more directly into multimodal understanding. MICap ( Raajesh et al., 2024 ) maintains anonymous person identities across a videoset of five consecutive clips by clustering faces and jointly learning identity assignment and caption generation. IDA-VLM ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , instead, conditions a vision-language model on reference images of known identities and requires the model to recognize those identities in new scenes before performing tasks such as localization, question answering, or captioning. ISYV ( Gao et al., 2026 ) extends this reference-conditioned setting to video, requiring the model to recognize and reason about a target person across time and shot transitions. Thus, these methods either learn identity consistency jointly with generation or require the multimodal model itself to infer the correspondence between a reference identity and its occurrence in the visual input.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作将身份更直接地纳入多式联运的理解。 MICap(Raajesh等,2024年)通过组合相貌和共同学习身份分配和字幕生成,在连续5个片段的视频集中保持匿名个人身份. IDA-VLM(Ji等,2025年)则在已知身份的参考图像上为视觉语言模型提供条件,并要求模型在完成本地化,问答或字幕等任务之前,在新场景中识别这些身份. ISYV(Gao等,2026年)将这种参考条件设置扩展到了视频,要求模型在跨时间和镜头过渡时识别目标人并给出理由. 因此,这些方法要么与生成者共同学习身份一致性,要么要求多式联运模式本身推断出参考身份与其在视觉输入中的发生之间的对应关系。

blocks.en: A complementary line of work studies region-level multimodal grounding. Omni-RGPT ( Heo et al., 2025 ) associates user-specified boxes or masks with language references to support region-specific reasoning over images and videos, while VideoGLaMM ( Munasinghe et al., 2025 ) grounds language in video at the pixel level through spatio-temporally consistent segmentation masks. These approaches demonstrate that explicit links between language and visual regions can support fine-grained reasoning, but they are not designed specifically to determine how known character identities should be represented to a general-purpose Video-MLLM.
blocks.zh: 区域一级多式联运基础研究的补充项目。 Omni-RGPT(Heo等,2025年)将用户专用的盒或口罩与语言参考,以支持区域对图像和视频的特有推理,而VideoGLAMM(Munasinghe等,2025年)则通过spatio-timpoly一致的分片口罩将视频中的语言在像素层面进行. 这些方法表明,语言和视觉区域之间的明确联系可以支持精细的推理,但是这些方法并不是专门用来确定如何将已知的人物身份表现为通用视频-MLLM.

blocks.en: Despite these advances, existing approaches do not address our central question: how should already known character identities be spatially represented to a general-purpose Video-MLLM so that it can reason about them throughout a video? We introduce this formulation by providing explicit identity-linked spatial cues whenever reliable detections and tracks are available, rather than requiring the model to recover identity solely from reference images or appearance. Importantly, these cues may be absent in some frames, requiring the Video-MLLM to propagate the available identity information across time and associate each character with their appearances, actions, locations, and interactions. We therefore investigate how different spatial representations of known identities enable identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering, without designing a dedicated region-aware architecture.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有做法并没有解决我们的中心问题:如何在空间上将已知的人物身份反映在一个通用的视频-MLLM中,以便它在整个视频中能够解释这些特征? 我们采用这种表述方式,在有可靠的探测和跟踪时提供与身份相关的明确空间提示,而不是要求模型仅从参考图像或外观中恢复身份。 重要的是,有些框架可能没有这些提示,要求视频-MLLM通过时间传播现有身份信息,并将每个字符与其外表、行动、地点和互动联系起来。 因此,我们调查已知身份的不同空间表达方式如何使了解身份的视频字幕和以人为中心的问题解答成为可能,而不设计专门的区域意识架构。

blocks.en: To study this question, we develop a pipeline on movie shots from LSMDC v2 in which detected faces are matched to actor reference images and identified characters are spatially grounded across sampled frames. We construct a manually verified benchmark of 750 captioned shots and 3,000 person-centric questions, and compare five identity-grounding representations ranging from textual coordinates to visual face or person boxes and their combinations. We evaluate them on identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering, then use the resulting grounding formulation to introduce BAC at three model scales (2B, 4B, and 8B). We compare BAC with Video-MLLMs of similar sizes from multiple model families and extend the evaluation to frontier open-weight and proprietary video-language models. We release approximately 32K synthetically captioned training clips and a manually verified benchmark of 750 clips and 3,000 questions, all with face bounding-box annotations, plus source code and trained checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 为了研究这个问题,我们开发了LSMDC v2电影镜头的管道,其中被探测到的面相与演员参考图像相匹配,识别出的角色在空间上被植入了被采样的框架. 我们构建了一个人工核实的基准,包括750个字幕镜头和3 000个以人为中心的问题,并比较了从文字坐标到视觉相貌或人相框及其组合的五个身份定位表示。 我们用了解身份的视频字幕和以人为中心的问题回答来评价它们,然后利用由此产生的地基设计,在三个模型尺度(2B、4B和8B)上引入BAC。 我们比较BAC与多个模型家庭大小相近的Video-MLLM,并将评价扩展到前沿开放量级和专有视频语言模型. 我们发布了大约32K个合成字幕培训剪辑,以及一个人工核实的基准,750个剪辑和3000个问题,都带有相框说明,加上源代码和训练有素的检查站。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Character Identification
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 特征识别

blocks.en: We build our dataset from the LSMDC v2 collection ( Rohrbach et al., 2017 ; Torabi et al., 2016 ; Maharaj et al., 2017 ) , downloading 92 movies comprising 46,756 video clips . Following cast-supervised character-identification approaches for movies and TV series ( Xu et al., 2010 ; Nagrani and Zisserman, 2018 ; Bamman et al., 2024 ) , we construct character-linked face tracks by combining cast information, actor reference images, face recognition, and temporal tracking.
blocks.zh: 我们从LSMDC v2集(Rohrbach等,2017年;Torabi等,2016年;Maharaj等,2017年)中构建了我们的数据集,下载了包含46,756个视频剪辑的92部电影. 根据电影和电视连续剧的被铸造监督的角色识别方法(徐等,2010;纳格拉尼和齐瑟曼,2018;巴姆曼等,2024),我们通过将铸造信息,演员参考影像,面相识别,以及时间跟踪结合起来,构建与角色相联的面相跟踪.

blocks.en: For each movie, we retrieve actor and character names from IMDb and collect up to 50 reference images per actor from DuckDuckGo. We filter low-quality or ambiguous images using InsightFace ( Deng et al., 2019 ) based on image resolution, face size, detection confidence, and face dominance. The remaining face embeddings are clustered to remove identity outliers, and the 5 most representative images are retained for each actor, forming a reliable reference gallery.
blocks.zh: 每部电影,我们从互联网电影数据库(IMDb)上检索出演员和角色名称,从DuckDuckGo上收集到每个演员多达50个参考图像. 使用InsightFace(Deng等,2019年)基于图像分辨率,面相大小,检测自信,以及面相优势来过滤低质量或模棱两可的图像. 其余的面相嵌入被分组去除身份外号,5个最具代表性的图像被保留给每个演员,形成一个可靠的参考画廊.

blocks.en: Each clip is then processed frame-by-frame with InsightFace to detect faces and extract 512-dimensional embeddings. A DeepSORT-inspired online tracker ( Wojke et al., 2017 ) links detections across consecutive frames into temporally consistent tracks. Each track is represented by a robust aggregate embedding and matched against the movie-specific reference gallery. The predicted identity is accepted when the matching confidence exceeds 0.30 and is propagated across the track together with its face bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 每段片段再用"Insight Face"逐帧地处理,以检测面相并提取出512维嵌入. 一个被DeepSORT所启发的在线跟踪器(Wojke等,2017年)将跨相继帧的检测连接到时间上一致的跟踪. 每个赛道都有一个强力的组合嵌入并配对出自电影特有参考画廊. 当匹配的置信度超过0.30时,可以接受预测的身份,并连同其相框被传播到整个赛道上.

blocks.en: Finally, because the original LSMDC clips may contain multiple camera shots with abrupt changes in scene or viewpoint, we split them into visually coherent shots using PySceneDetect. This produces 54,133 shots , with an average duration of 2.50 s , and an average of 1.7 shots per clip .
blocks.zh: 最后,由于最初的LSMDC片段可能包含多个相机镜头,场景或视线突然变化,所以我们利用PyScene Detective将其分为视觉相通镜头. 这产生了54 133发子弹,平均持续时间为2.50 s,平均每发子弹1.7发。

blocks.en: 2.1.2 Caption and Question Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1.2 说明和问题产生

blocks.en: Given the short shot duration, averaging approximately 2.5 s at 24 fps, we uniformly sample 8 frames per shot. As illustrated in Figure 1 , these frames provide sufficient temporal coverage of the main actions. From the 54,133 detected shots, we retain only those containing at least one identity-linked bounding box in at least one sampled frame. Preserving the original LSMDC v2 movie-level split, this yields 31,935 shots from 72 training movies and 6,219 shots from 12 test movies. The training set is further divided into 28,742 training and 3,193 validation shots, with the validation split used for BAC hyperparameter tuning.
blocks.zh: 由于拍摄时间很短,平均在24英尺时大约2.5秒,我们统一抽取了每发8帧. 如图1所示,这些框架为主要行动提供了足够的时间范围。 从54 133发侦测到的镜头中,我们只保留至少一个样本框中包含至少一个与身份相接的边框的镜头. 保留了最初的LSMDC v2电影分级,这从72个训练电影中收获了31,935个镜头,从12个测试电影中收获了6,219个镜头. 该训练集又被进一步分为28,742个训练集和3,193个验证镜头,其中BAC超参数调试使用的验证分出.

blocks.en: For both training and test shots, the sampled frames are provided to Gemini 2.5 Flash to generate identity-aware captions. For test shots, the model is additionally instructed to generate four person-centric questions and to assess shot validity, visual and temporal coherence, and identity-grounding difficulty. We retain shots that are valid, high-quality, and challenging, with coherence scores of at least 9 and challenge scores of at least 8.5. This favors non-trivial cases involving multiple people, distractors, occlusions, interactions, or viewpoint changes, yielding 2,008 shots.
blocks.zh: 对于培训和测试镜头,样本框都提供给双子座2.5 Flash,以生成能识别身份的字幕. 对于测试镜头,该模型被额外指示生成四个以人为中心的问题并评估镜头有效性,视觉和时间一致性,以及身份定位难度. 我们保留有效、高质量和具有挑战性的镜头,一致性分数至少为9分,挑战分数至少为8.5分。 这有利于涉及多人、分心者、隔离者、互动者或观点变化的非部落案件,产生2 008个镜头。

blocks.en: Finally, from the 2,008 retained shots, we manually review and correct the captions, questions, and answers. We remove redundant or ambiguous examples and refine overly simple questions to require more precise identity grounding. This curation produces a final evaluation benchmark of 750 captioned shots and 3,000 person-centric questions.
blocks.zh: 最后,从2 008个保留镜头,我们手动审查并纠正标题、问答。 我们删除了多余或模棱两可的例子,并完善了过于简单的问题,需要更精确地确定身份。 这份综述产生了750个字幕镜头和3 000个以人为中心的问题的最终评价基准。

blocks.en: 2.2 Identity-grounding representations
blocks.zh: 2.2 身份证明说明

blocks.en: Once character identities and their locations have been established, we investigate how these identity–location associations should be represented to a general-purpose Video-MLLM. We consider five grounding strategies that differ in whether spatial information is conveyed through textual coordinates, visual annotations, or a combination of both. Each identified character is assigned an identifier P i P_{i} , which is consistently mapped to the same identity throughout the shot.
blocks.zh: 一旦品行身份及其位置确定,我们就调查这些身份-地点协会应如何被代表到通用视频-MLM中去。 我们认为,在空间信息是通过文字坐标、视觉说明还是两者的结合传递方面,有五个不同的基础战略。 每一个识别出的角色都被分配到一个标识符P i P_{i},在整个拍摄过程中,该标识被一致地映射到同一个身份.

blocks.en: Face Textual Coordinates (FTC). The sampled frames are provided without visual bounding-box annotations. The prompt specifies the identity associated with each P i P_{i} together with the textual coordinates of its face bounding box for every frame in which the character is localized. This representation evaluates whether the Video-MLLM can establish the identity–location association using textual spatial information alone.
blocks.zh: Face Textual 坐标(FTC). 样本框的提供没有视觉边框-框说明. 该提示指定了每个P i P {i} 相关的身份, 以及每个字符本地化框架的面框文字坐标 。 这种表述评价了Video-MLLM是否能够仅使用文字空间信息建立身份-位置关联.

blocks.en: For strategies involving visual grounding, a bounding box is drawn around each localized character, with the corresponding P i P_{i} displayed at its upper-left corner. For a given identity, the box and label use the same color across frames, providing a consistent identity-linked visual cue. The P i P_{i} label size is scaled with the bounding box to remain visible while limiting occlusion. Figure 1 illustrates this visual identity-grounding process.
blocks.zh: 对于涉及视觉地平面的策略,每个局部字符周围会画出一个边框,相应的P i P _{i}显示在它的左上角. 对于给定的身份,盒子和标签使用相同的颜色横跨框架,提供一致的与身份相联的视觉提示. P i P_{i} 标签大小随边框缩放以保持可见,同时限制封入. 图1说明了这种视觉身份定位过程。

blocks.en: Face Visual Boxes (FVB). Each identified character is visually grounded using its face bounding box. No bounding-box coordinates are provided in the textual prompt, such that the identity–location association is conveyed exclusively through the visual face annotations.
blocks.zh: 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 每个被识别的字符都使用其相框进行视像定位. 文字提示中未提供边框坐标,因此,身份-位置关联完全通过可视面说明传递。

blocks.en: Person Visual Boxes (PVB). Each identified character is visually grounded using an estimated person-level bounding box. Rather than requiring an additional person detector, we extrapolate the person box from the detected face using a lightweight anthropometric heuristic based on fixed face-to-body proportions ( Jaruenpunyasak et al., 2022 ) . Details of the estimation procedure are provided in Appendix A . In this method, no spatial coordinates are included in the prompt; identity–location associations are conveyed solely through person-level visual annotations.
blocks.zh: 人物视觉盒 (PVB). 每个识别的字符都使用估计的人级界限框进行视像定位。 我们不要求增加一个人的探测器,而是使用基于固定的面相对身体比例的轻量级人体测高法,从被探测出的脸部推断出人盒(Jaruenpunyasak等,2022年)。 估计程序的细节见附录A。 在这种方法中,不包含空间坐标;身份-位置关联仅通过人级视觉说明来传递。

blocks.en: Face Visual Boxes + Face Textual Coordinates (FVB+FTC). Each identified character is visually grounded using its face bounding box. In addition to the visual annotation, the prompt provides the textual coordinates of the corresponding face bounding box for each frame.
blocks.zh: 相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 每个被识别的字符都使用其相框进行视像定位. 除了可视化注释外,提示提供每个帧的相应面框的文字坐标.

blocks.en: Person Visual Boxes + Person Textual Coordinates (PVB+PTC). Each identified character is visually grounded using an estimated person-level bounding box. In addition to the visual annotation, the prompt provides the textual coordinates of the corresponding estimated person bounding box for each frame.
blocks.zh: 人物视觉盒+人物文字坐标(PVB+PTC). 每个识别的字符都使用估计的人级界限框进行视像定位。 除了可视化注释外,提示提供每个帧的相应估计人边框的文字坐标.

blocks.en: Together, these five representations allow us to compare textual grounding, visual grounding, and their combination, while also examining whether face-level or person-level spatial cues are more effective for identity-aware video understanding.
blocks.zh: 这五种表达方式共同让我们可以比较文字地平面,视觉地平面,以及它们的组合,同时检查面相或人相地平面空间提示对于了解身份的视频是否更有效.

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental Protocol
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate the proposed identity-grounding representations on two complementary tasks: identity-aware video captioning and person-centric question answering. All experiments are conducted on the manually verified evaluation set of 750 video clips, comprising 3,000 identity-related questions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价拟议的以身份为基础的陈述,这是两个相辅相成的任务:身份意识视频字幕和以人为中心的问题回答。 所有实验都是对750个录像片段进行人工核查的评价,其中包括3 000个与身份有关的问题。

blocks.en: We conduct three complementary sets of experiments. First, we study the effect of the grounding representation while keeping the Video-MLLM family fixed. We compare the five representations introduced above: FTC, FVB, PVB, FVB+FCT, and PVB+PTC. This comparison is performed with Qwen3 models at approximately 2B, 4B, and 8B parameters, allowing us to examine how the effectiveness of each grounding representation evolves with model scale.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了三组互补的实验. 首先,我们在保持视频-MLLM家族固定的同时,研究定位代表的影响。 我们比较了上文介绍的五种表述:公平贸易委员会、公平贸易局、公平贸易局、公平贸易局、公平贸易局+公平贸易局和公平贸易局+公平贸易局。 这种比较是在大约2B、4B和8B参数下与Qune3模型进行的,使我们能够审查每个地基代表的有效性如何随着模型尺度的发展而演变。

blocks.en: Second, we investigate whether the benefits of identity grounding generalize across different Video-MLLM families. Models are grouped into three approximate parameter scales: 2B, 4B, and 8B–9B. At the 2B scale, we evaluate Qwen3, InternVL3.5; at the 4B scale, we evaluate Qwen3, InternVL3.5, MiniCPM-V, and Ovis2.5; and at the 8B–9B scale, we evaluate Qwen3, Ovis2, InternVL3.5, Eagle2.5, and Molmo2. The same clips, questions, prompts, identity annotations, and grounding representations are used across models within each comparison.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们调查身份的好处是否贯穿不同Video-MLLM家族。 模型分为三个大致参数尺度:2B、4B和8B-9B。 在2B级,我们评价Quen3, InternVL3.5;在4B级,我们评价Quen3, InternVL3.5, MiniCPM-V和Ovis2.5;在8B-9B级,我们评价Quen3, Ovis2, InternVL3.5, Eagle2.5和Molmo2. 同样的剪辑,提问,提示,身份说明,以及地基表示,在每次比较中都会被跨模型所使用.

blocks.en: Third, we introduce BAC, obtained by fine-tuning the Qwen model family at three scales (2B, 4B, and 8B) using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The models are trained on our training split using ≈ 32 ​ K \approx 32\text{K} identity-aware captions generated by Gemini as supervision, as described in Section 2.1.2 , and are evaluated on the manually verified evaluation set. This stage assesses whether task-specific, parameter-efficient adaptation can further improve identity-aware video understanding when combined with explicit identity grounding.
blocks.zh: 第三,我们引入BAC,通过微调使用Low-Rank适应(LORA)在三个尺度(2B,4B,8B)上的Quen模型家族获得. 如第2.1.2节所描述的,这些模型是使用双子座作为监理而生成的能识别身份的字幕进行关于我们训练分解的训练,并在人工核实的评价集上进行评价。 这一阶段评估具体任务、参数效率高的适应与明确身份定位相结合,能否进一步提高对身份意识的视频理解。

blocks.en: For captioning, each model receives the grounded video shot and is instructed to generate a description referring to identified characters using their corresponding P i P_{i} identifiers. For question answering, the model receives the same grounded shot together with one person-centric question at a time and returns the corresponding P i P_{i} , or UNIDENTIFIED (UNID) when the queried person cannot be associated with any provided identity. The predicted P i P_{i} identifiers are subsequently mapped to their corresponding character names for evaluation and qualitative presentation.
blocks.zh: 对于字幕,每个模型都会收到被禁入的视频镜头,并被指示使用相应的P i P_{i}标识符生成被识别字符的描述. 为了回答问题,当被询问者无法与所提供的任何身份相关联时,模型一次收到相同的被询问镜头和一个以人为中心的问题,并返回相应的P i P {i},或UNIDENTIFIED(UNID)。 预测的P i P_{i}标识符随后被绘制到相应的字符名上,用于评价和定性展示.

blocks.en: Except for the LoRA adaptation experiments, all models are evaluated without task-specific fine-tuning. We use a consistent prompting protocol within each task and keep the generation configuration fixed for each model across the compared grounding representations.
blocks.zh: 除了LORA的适应实验外,所有模型都未经特定任务的微调而得到评价. 我们在每个任务中都采用一致的提示协议,并保持每个模型的生成配置固定在比较的地基表示上.

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价计量

blocks.en: Person-centric question answering: QA predictions are compared directly with the ground-truth identity. We report QA Overall Accuracy over all 3,000 questions, of which 2,074 target a known character and 926 correspond to UNIDENTIFIED cases. QA Named Accuracy is computed over the 2,074 questions targeting a known character, while QA UNIDENTIFIED Accuracy is computed over the 926 questions referring to a person who cannot be associated with any of the provided character identities. We additionally report QA Clip-Level Accuracy, defined as the percentage of clips for which all four associated questions are answered correctly.
blocks.zh: 以人为中心的问题回答:QA的预测直接被与地面真实身份相比较. 我们报告QA对全部3 000个问题的总体准确性,其中2 074个针对一个已知字符,926个针对UIDIFIED案件。 QA 命名精确度是针对已知字符的2 074个问题计算的,而QA UNIDITIFIED 精确度是针对无法与任何提供字符身份相关联的人的926个问题计算的。 我们另外报告QA Clip-Level精确度,定义为所有四个相关问题都得到正确回答的剪辑百分比.

blocks.en: Identity-aware captioning: Evaluating identity accuracy against a single ground-truth caption is unreliable because two correct captions may describe different visible attributes of the same character, such as a shirt, skirt, or hat. Manual evaluation is also impractical at scale. We therefore use a VLM-as-a-judge protocol based on Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, an open-weight 27B vision-language model achieving 94% accuracy on our person-centric QA task. The judge receives the video shot, identity grounding, and generated caption, and evaluates identity correctness, hallucination, visual faithfulness, and naturalness. We report Caption Overall, the mean quality score on a 0–10 scale; Caption Identity, the percentage of shots where every queried character is mentioned and correctly identified; and Caption Hallucination, the percentage containing an unsupported person, identity, or absent object.
blocks.zh: 识别识别标题 : 对照单一的地真字幕评价身份准确性是不可靠的,因为两个正确的字幕可能描述同一字符的不同可见属性,如衬衫,裙子或帽子. 手工评估在规模上也是不切实际的。 因此,我们使用基于Quen/Quen3.8-27B-FP8的VLM-as-judge协议,一个开口量的27B视觉语言模型,在我们以人为中心的QA任务上达到94%的精度. 法官接收视频拍摄、身份定位和生成字幕,评价身份正确性、幻觉、视觉忠诚和自然。 我们报告总体说明,平均质量得分为0-10分; 说明身份,每个被询问的字符被提及和正确识别的镜头百分比; 说明幻觉,包含一个不支持的人、身份或缺失物体的百分比。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Effect of Identity Grounding Strategies
blocks.zh: 3.1 确定身份战略的效果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that explicit visual grounding substantially improves person-centric QA over FTC alone. QA Overall increases from 53.87% to 68.90% at 2B, from 62.57% to 79.73% at 4B, and from 59.77% to 88.53% at 8B. Paired McNemar tests confirm that FTC is significantly worse than every visually grounded variant at all model sizes ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Excluding FTC, differences among the grounded variants become smaller with scale. At 2B, FVB+FTC achieves the highest accuracy and significantly outperforms PVB+PTC and PVB, while remaining statistically indistinguishable from FVB. At 4B and 8B, FVB+FTC, FVB, and PVB+PTC consistently form the top statistical group, while PVB remains significantly weaker.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,仅凭目视定位就大大改善了以人为中心的质量保证,而不是公平贸易委员会。 质量保证 2B型机车从53.87%增至68.90%,4B型机车从62.57%增至79.73%,8B型机车从59.77%增至88.53%. Paired McNemar测试证实,FTC明显比每个视网膜的变体都差(p < 0.001 p < .001)。 除公平贸易委员会外,基于理由的变体之间的差别随着规模而缩小。 在2B时,FVB+FTC的精度最高并显著地超过PVB+PTC和PVB,同时在统计学上仍然与FVB无法区分. 在4B和8B时,FVB+FTC,FVB和PVB+PTC始终是最高统计组,而PVB则仍然显著地弱.

blocks.en: For captioning, the effect of the grounding representation is most pronounced at small model scale. At 2B, FVB+FTC clearly outperforms the other strategies in identity accuracy, with all pairwise differences being statistically significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). As model size increases, these differences shrink substantially: at 4B, the visually grounded variants are mostly statistically indistinguishable, with only FVB+FTC outperforming FVB, while at 8B all four visually grounded strategies are statistically tied. In contrast, FTC remains significantly worse than every visually grounded variant at 4B and 8B ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 就标题而言,地面代表的作用在小型模型规模中最为明显。 在2B时,FVB+FTC在身份准确性方面明显优于其他战略,所有对等差异在统计学上都是显著的(p < 0.001 p < .001)。 随着模型尺寸的扩大,这些差异大大缩小:在4B,视基变量大多在统计学上无法区分,只有FVB+FTC优于FVB;在8B,所有四种视基策略在统计学上都是捆绑的. 相比之下,公平贸易委员会仍然比4B和8B的每个视基变体都差得多( < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en: Overall, FVB+FTC provides the most consistent captioning and QA performance across scales, particularly at 2B. We therefore analyze whether its remaining errors depend on grounded face size. For QA, face-box area correlates positively with correctness, increasing from r s = 0.103 r_{s}=0.103 at 2B to r s = 0.245 r_{s}=0.245 at 8B, while captioning shows a stronger and stable association ( r s = 0.238 r_{s}=0.238 – 0.256 0.256 ). PVB+PTC is less sensitive to box size, likely because the full-person box covers a much larger visual region than the face alone.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,FVB+FTC提供最一致的标注和质量保证业绩,特别是在2B级。 因此,我们分析其剩余错误是否取决于有根据的面相大小。 对QA来说,面框区域与正确性有正相关,从2B的r = 0.103 r_{s}=0.103增加到8B的r = 0.245 rss}=0.245,而字幕则显示一个更强而稳定的关联(r s = 0.238 r_{s}=0.238 – 0.256 – 0.256 ). PVB+PTC对盒子大小的敏感度较低,可能是因为全人盒覆盖的视觉区域比面部要大得多.

blocks.en: Results grouped by size confirm this pattern. At 2B (Table 2 ), PVB+PTC performs better for small faces ( < 4,000 <4{,}000 px 2 ), reaching 91.8% versus 80.0% for FVB+FTC ( p = 0.021 p=0.021 ). For medium and large faces, FVB+FTC performs better, reaching 92.8% vs. 91.3% and 96.8% vs. 91.1%, respectively. These results suggest that full-person grounding can compensate when the face is very small, whereas face-based grounding becomes more effective once the face is sufficiently visible; expanding the grounding to the full person may then introduce less precise spatial information. Qualitative examples of both cases are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 按规模分类的结果证实了这一模式。 在2B(表2)中,PVB+PTC对小面孔的性能较好( <4,000 < 4{,}000 px 2),FVB+FTC为91.8%,而FTC为80.0%(p=0.021 p=0.021),对于中大面孔,FVB+FTC的性能较好,分别为92.8%对91.3%和96.8%对91.1%. 这些结果表明,当面部非常小时,全人地面可以补偿,而面部地面则在面部足够可见后变得更加有效;然后将地面扩大到全人可能引入更精确的空间信息. 附录B提供了两个案例的定性实例。

blocks.en: The Named and UNIDENTIFIED results further reveal how grounding affects identity assignment. At 2B and 4B, the combined visual–textual strategies favor assigning known identities: FVB+FTC and PVB+PTC achieve the highest Named accuracy, while remaining substantially weaker on UNIDENTIFIED cases. Visual-only grounding generally reduces this imbalance, improving the rejection of unidentified characters at the cost of lower Named accuracy. This asymmetry decreases markedly with model scale. At 8B, FVB+FTC achieves nearly balanced performance between Named and UNIDENTIFIED identities (88.04% and 86.93%), indicating that larger models are better able to use the grounding signal without systematically forcing a known identity when the evidence is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 命名结果和统一结果进一步揭示了基础如何影响身份分配。 在2B和4B时,综合视觉-文字策略倾向于指定已知身份:FVB+FTC和PVB+PTC的命名精确度最高,而UNIDITIFED案例则仍然大大弱。 仅可视化地基一般会减少这种不平衡,以更低的命名精度来改进对未识别字符的拒绝. 这种不对称随着模型尺度而明显减少. 在8B时,FVB+FTC在命名身份和UNIDTIFIED身份之间实现了近乎平衡的性能(88.04%和86.93%),表明较大的型号在证据不足时可以更好地使用地平线信号而不会系统性地强迫已知身份.

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmarking Across Model Families
blocks.zh: 3.2 跨模范家庭基准

blocks.en: Table 3 compares BAC with several VLM families at comparable parameter scales using the FVB+FTC grounding method. We first focus on the base models to identify the strongest backbone before examining the effect of BAC fine-tuning. Among the base models, Qwen3 provides the strongest overall balance, achieving the highest QA accuracy within each size group together with consistently strong captioning performance. Its QA advantage over the strongest competing base model is statistically significant at 2B, 4B, and 8–9B ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , paired McNemar tests). At 8–9B, Ovis2.5 attains higher caption identity accuracy than Qwen3 (93.73% vs. 91.60%), but the difference is not significant ( p = 0.089 p=0.089 ).
blocks.zh: 表3使用FVB+FTC地基法,比较了几个可比参数尺度的VLM家族的BAC. 我们首先注重基础模型,在检查BAC微调的效果之前确定最强的主干线. 在基数模型中,Quen3提供了最强的整体平衡,在每个尺寸组内实现了最高的QA精度,同时始终保持了强大的字幕性能. 在2B、4B和8-9B(p < 0.001 p < 0.001,配对的麦克尼马尔测试),其质量评估优于最强的相互竞争的基础模型在统计学上具有重大意义。 8–9B时,Ovis2.5获得比Quen3更高的标题标识精度(93.73%对91.60%),但差异并不显著(p=0.089 p=0.089).

blocks.en: We then examine the effect of BAC fine-tuning on the Qwen3 backbone. The best configuration identified by our fine-tuning sweep uses a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , LoRA rank r = 16 r=16 , scaling factor α = 32 \alpha=32 , and dropout 0.05 0.05 . This configuration shows stable training and validation convergence across all three model scales, with full optimization details and learning curves provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 然后审查BAC微调对Quen3主干线的影响. 微调扫描确定的最佳配置使用5×10−5 5\times 10×5},LORA排名r=16 r=16;缩放系数α=32\alpha=32;辍学率0.050.05。 这种配置在所有三个模型尺度上都显示出了稳定的培训和验证趋同,附录C提供了完整的优化细节和学习曲线.

blocks.en: BAC substantially improves the corresponding Qwen3 baseline at every scale. Although BAC is trained only on the captioning task, it generalizes strongly to person-centric QA without QA-specific supervision. QA accuracy increases from 68.90% to 80.33% at 2B, from 79.73% to 90.13% at 4B, and from 87.70% to 93.20% at 8B; all three improvements are statistically significant ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). The gains are especially large for UNIDENTIFIED questions at 2B and 4B. Figure 2 (a) qualitatively illustrates this improvement, with BAC correctly predicting UNIDENTIFIED across all three model scales while the corresponding Qwen3-VL baselines fail. Named accuracy also remains high, indicating that adaptation improves the model’s ability to distinguish grounded identities from people whose identity is not provided.

blocks.en: Captioning follows the same trend: BAC improves overall quality and identity accuracy at all three scales while maintaining a low hallucination rate. BAC-2B already slightly exceeds the strongest 4B base model in QA (80.33% vs. 79.73%), while BAC-4B surpasses all evaluated 8–9B base models (90.13% vs. 87.70% for the strongest baseline). The relative improvement decreases as model size grows, suggesting that task-specific adaptation is particularly beneficial for smaller models, where identity grounding is more challenging.
blocks.zh: 说明也遵循了同一种趋势:BAC提高了所有三个尺度的整体质量和身份精度,同时保持了较低的幻觉率. BAC-2B已经略微超过QA中最强的4B基模型(80.33%对79.73%),而BAC-4B则超过了所有被评价的8-9B基模型(90.13%对87.70%对最强基准). 随着模型规模的扩大,相对的改进会减少,这表明针对具体任务的适应对较小的模型特别有利,因为在那里,身份定位更具挑战性。

BAC-8B reaches 93.20% overall, with balanced performance on Named (93.88%) and UNIDENTIFIED (91.68%) questions. Although it remains significantly below GPT-5.6 Sol ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), BAC-8B significantly outperforms Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (86.10%), Gemini 2.5 Flash (82.63%), and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (76.10%), all with p < 0.001 p<0.001 .

BAC-4B reaches 90.13% overall accuracy and significantly surpasses the much larger Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B by 4.03 percentage points ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), while achieving 96.38% accuracy on Named questions. BAC-2B also reaches 80.33%, significantly outperforming Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), although it remains below Gemini 2.5 Flash and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B. Overall, these results show that BAC substantially narrows the gap to frontier proprietary models while remaining compact, open-weight, and self-hostable. blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We introduced a framework for identity-aware video understanding that combines automatic character identification with explicit spatial grounding for video captioning and person-centric question answering. Using LSMDC v2, we constructed a manually verified benchmark of 750 captioned clips and 3,000 questions, and systematically evaluated five identity-grounding representations across multiple model scales and families. Our results show that explicit visual grounding substantially improves identity association compared with textual coordinates alone, with face-based visual grounding combined with textual coordinates providing the most consistent performance across scales. Building on this formulation, we introduced BAC through LoRA-based fine-tuning of Qwen models at 2B, 4B, and 8B scales. BAC-8B achieves 93.20% QA accuracy and remains competitive with substantially larger frontier Video-MLLMs, while maintaining strong performance across question categories. Overall, the results show that explicitly communicating who is where, together with task-specific adaptation, provides an effective approach to improving identity-aware video understanding without requiring changes to the underlying Video-MLLM architecture.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了一个认识身份的视频理解框架,该框架将自动字符识别与清晰的视频字幕空间定位和以人为中心的问答相结合。 利用LSMDC v2,我们构建了一个人工核实的基准,包括750个字幕片段和3000个问题,并系统地评价了五个不同模型尺度和家庭的身份定位表述。 我们的结果表明,与文字坐标相比,清晰的视觉定位大大改进了身份联系,与文字坐标相结合的面部视觉定位和文字坐标提供了最一致的跨尺度性能。 在此基础上,我们通过基于LORA的微调在2B,4B,8B等尺度上引入了BAC. BAC-8B的QA精度达到93.20%,与大得多的前沿视频-MLLM保持竞争力,同时保持了各问题类别的强效性能. 总体而言,结果显示,明确沟通谁在哪里,以及具体任务的调整,提供了一种有效的方法来改进对身份认识的视频的了解,而无需改变基本的视频-MLLM架构。

blocks.en: 5 Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 5 道德考虑

blocks.en: Our approach combines face recognition, temporal tracking, and spatial grounding to associate known identities with their appearances, actions, and interactions across video frames. Although we study this capability only in the controlled setting of movie understanding, using predefined cast identities and movie clips, similar techniques could potentially be adapted to identify and track individuals in real-world footage, raising concerns related to privacy, surveillance, and unauthorized profiling. Our work is intended to advance character-centric video understanding rather than person identification in unconstrained real-world environments, and we do not evaluate or advocate its use for surveillance or monitoring applications. We therefore encourage future applications of identity-aware video understanding to consider appropriate consent, privacy protections, and restrictions on the use of biometric identity information.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法结合了面相识别、时间跟踪和空间定位,将已知身份与其外表、行动和跨视频框的互动联系起来。 虽然我们只是在电影理解的可控环境中研究这种能力,使用预先定义的铸造身份和电影片段,但类似的技术有可能被改造,以识别和追踪现实世界镜头中的个人,引起与隐私、监视和未经授权的定性有关的关注。 我们的工作是为了在不受限制的现实环境中推进以人物为中心的视频理解,而不是个人身份识别,我们不评价或主张将其用于监视或监测应用. 因此,我们鼓励今后采用了解身份的视频理解,以考虑适当的同意、隐私保护以及对使用生物鉴别身份信息的限制。

blocks.en: Appendix C BAC Fine-Tuning and Model Scaling
blocks.zh: 附录C 微调和模型缩放

blocks.en: Our objective is to fine-tune Qwen3-VL base models at different scales on the training data we build as described in Section 2.1.2 . We consider the 2B, 4B, and 8B variants and perform parameter-efficient adaptation using LoRA. We refer to the resulting fine-tuned models as BAC-2B , BAC-4B , and BAC-8B . The adapters are applied only to the language-model projection layers, while the vision encoder and multimodal projector remain frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是根据我们所建立的培训数据,按照第2.1.2节所述,在不同尺度上微调Quen3-VL的基础模型。 我们考虑2B,4B,和8B等变体,并利用LORA进行参数高效的适应. 我们把由此产生的微调模型称为BAC-2B、BAC-4B和BAC-8B。 适配器只适用于语言模型投影层,而视觉编码器和多式投影器则仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: To determine an effective LoRA configuration, we conduct a five-setting hyperparameter sweep for one epoch, varying the learning rate, LoRA rank r r , scaling factor α \alpha , and dropout. The best configuration is obtained with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} , r = 16 r=16 , α = 32 \alpha=32 , and a dropout of 0.05 0.05 . At this rank, LoRA introduces 17.4 17.4 M trainable parameters for BAC-2B, 33.0 33.0 M for BAC-4B, and 43.6 43.6 M for BAC-8B. blocks.en: Figure 6 provides a category-wise breakdown of person-centric QA performance across both frontier and similarly sized models. Overall, BAC-8B maintains strong performance across all question types, indicating that task-specific adaptation benefits a broad range of identity-aware reasoning categories.
blocks.zh: 图6按类别分列了以人为中心的质量评估在前沿和类似大小模型上的性能。 总体而言,BAC-8B在所有问题类型中都保持了强劲的性能,表明针对具体任务的适应有利于一系列广泛的身份意识推理类别。

blocks.en: Among frontier models, GPT-5.6 Sol thinking achieves the highest accuracy across all categories, while BAC-8B remains competitive, with its strongest absolute results on appearance, object, and posture questions and its lowest performance on position. BAC-4B follows a similar pattern, whereas BAC-2B substantially larger variation across categories. Among 8–9B models, BAC-8B achieves the highest accuracy in every category and consistently outperforms its Qwen3-VL 8B base, with the largest gains over the base model observed for object, appearance, and posture questions.
blocks.zh: 在前沿模型中,GPT-5.6 索尔思维在所有类别中都实现了最高的精确度,而BAC-8B依然具有竞争力,在外观,物体,和姿势等问题上,其绝对结果最强,在位置上表现最差. BAC-4B的格局类似,而BAC-2B的类别差异大得多。 在8-9B模型中,BAC-8B在每个类别中都实现了最高的精度,并始终超越了它的Quen3-VL 8B基数,与观测到的物体,外观,姿势问题的基准模型相比,收益最大.
